sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 210 AND fish_date_doy <= 244 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 310 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 265 AND fish_date_doy <= 275 ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 'Missed late Aug/Sept peaks' as window, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fish_date_doy >= 225 AND fish_date_doy <= 238 AND cls IN ('multi_day', 'day_1_5') THEN yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0) END), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler FROM trips
